list_files_s3_bucket: list files from an S3 bucket path and filter by allow and ignore patterns
glob_s3_files: glob S3 paths under a bucket prefix and filter by an allow pattern
filter_allow_s3_paths: filter a list of S3 paths keeping only those matching allow patterns
filter_ignore_s3_paths: filter a list of S3 paths removing those matching ignore patterns
build_s3_file_list: build a list of S3 file keys from a bucket and prefix with pattern filtering
